title: Align remaining test names with Late and the reviewed labels
public_pr_body:
Update remaining test names and comments to the reviewed wording: jobs say Late, the RFQ heading is Waiting for details, and the support action is Switch off support access. This follows #188/#194; the selector updates already on those branches are retained.

Base: codex2/wording-pass-2 (#194), so tests stay paired with the product wording they describe. Only tests change. Assertions, invoice wording, status keys, database/API terms and the actual unchanged RFQ toast are untouched.

Validation: focused status-badge and admin-owner tests passed, RFQ browser tests collect, targeted ESLint and whitespace checks passed. Live browser and database execution were not run; the database-test change is a comment only. No SQL applied.
